меня зовут.en: my name is… (lit. they call me)

corpus.en: I read the book (all of it).
We live in a big house.
Without water there is no life.
I have a lot of friends.

corpus.ru: Мы с дру́гом игра́ем в волейбо́л.
corpus.en: My friend and I play volleyball.
We are going to another city.
I'm writing a letter to my brother.
The little cats are at home.
I don't have a big house.
I'm playing with my little brother.
I'm reading with my little sister.
I'm thinking about the new city.
The book is in the new car.
There are four books on the table.
I get up at six o'clock.
There are seven days in a week.
I have a lesson at eight.
How old are you? (to a friend)
There are ten books on the table.
Where are you from? (to a friend)
Excuse me, where is the metro?

corpus.ru: Я студе́нт. Я учу́сь в университе́те.
corpus.en: I'm a student. I study at university.
Where is my phone? — It's here.
Where is the book? — It's on the table.
Where is the letter? — It's here.
Where are they? — They are at home.

corpus.ru: У тебя́ есть телефо́н? — Да, есть.
corpus.en: Do you have a phone? — Yes, I do.
Do you have a car? — No.
I call my mum every day.
My grandma lives in the city.

corpus.ru: У меня́ два бра́та и одна́ сестра́.
corpus.en: I have two brothers and one sister.
How many brothers do you have?

corpus.ru: Я из Ли́вии, но сейча́с я живу́ в Ри́ге.
corpus.en: I'm from Libya, but now I live in Riga.

corpus.ru: У меня́ есть брат и сестра́.
corpus.en: I have a brother and a sister.

corpus.ru: Моя́ сестра́ ма́ленькая, ей пять лет.
corpus.en: My sister is little, she is five.

corpus.ru: Я чита́ю кни́ги и смотрю́ фи́льмы по-ру́сски.
corpus.en: I read books and watch films in Russian.

corpus.ru: Я ещё пло́хо понима́ю, но я учу́ ру́сский язы́к ка́ждый день.
corpus.en: I still understand poorly, but I learn Russian every day.
One coffee and some water, please.
A big or a small coffee?
Small, please. How much is it?

corpus.ru: Ко́фе сто́ит три е́вро, вода́ — два е́вро.
corpus.en: The coffee is three euros, the water two euros.
Thank you! Have a nice day!
Barsik is small but very smart.

corpus.ru: Ка́ждое у́тро он смо́трит в окно́.
corpus.en: Every morning he looks out of the window.

corpus.ru: Он ви́дит большо́й го́род, маши́ны и люде́й.
corpus.en: He sees the big city, cars and people.
In the daytime Barsik sleeps on the books.

corpus.ru: Ба́рсик не уме́ет чита́ть, но он всё понима́ет.
corpus.en: Barsik can't read, but he understands everything.
Hi! Are you a new student?

corpus.ru: Да. Меня́ зову́т Али́. А тебя́?
corpus.en: Yes. My name is Ali. And yours?
I'm Anna. Nice to meet you!
Me too. Are you from Riga?

corpus.ru: Да, я из Ри́ги. А ты отку́да?
corpus.en: Yes, I'm from Riga. And where are you from?
A little. I'm still learning Russian.

corpus.ru: Спаси́бо! Како́й у тебя́ но́мер телефо́на?
Два, три, пять, во́семь, ноль, оди́н, де́вять, де́вять.
corpus.en: Two, three, five, eight, zero, one, nine, nine.

corpus.ru: Нет, молока́ сейча́с нет. Есть вода́ и сок.
corpus.en: No, there's no milk right now. There's water and juice.

corpus.ru: Хлеб — оди́н е́вро, сок — два е́вро. Всего́ три е́вро.
corpus.en: Bread is one euro, juice two euros. Three euros in total.
Who is that in the photo?

corpus.ru: Э́то моя́ семья́. Вот мой па́па и моя́ ма́ма.
corpus.en: This is my family. Here are my dad and my mum.

corpus.ru: Э́то мой брат. Его́ зову́т Ома́р. Ему́ два́дцать три го́да.
corpus.en: That's my brother. His name is Omar. He is twenty-three.

corpus.ru: Э́то моя́ сестра́ Ле́йла. Ей пять лет.
corpus.en: That's my sister Leila. She is five.

corpus.ru: Кака́я краси́вая! У тебя́ больша́я семья́.
corpus.en: How pretty! You have a big family.

corpus.ru: Да. А у тебя́ есть бра́тья и́ли сёстры?
corpus.en: Yes. And do you have brothers or sisters?

corpus.ru: Нет, у меня́ нет ни бра́та, ни сестры́. Но у меня́ есть кот!
corpus.en: No, I have neither a brother nor a sister. But I have a cat!
Ha-ha, a cat is family too!
Can I have the book, please?
There are a lot of people here.
In the daytime I'm at university.
Excuse me, do you speak English?

corpus.ru: У меня́ нет ни ко́фе, ни ча́я.
corpus.en: I have neither coffee nor tea.
My number is two, zero, five.
My name is Anna. — Nice to meet you!
Where's the window? — There it is.
I didn't get it. Please repeat.
She read the letter (to the end).
